_comment: Hardware bank for the ported gen_random_workload.py, holding only the
config this sweep runs on. The FPGA sweep's bank had two machines
(gemmini_q31 CPU_P + rvv_f16 CPU_E); this board has three lanes, so
CPU_X is added and the packing problem is not the same shape. Arms are
matched to each other WITHIN this target only.
machines/profile_hw/profile are copied verbatim into every generated
workload's `hardware` block, and they are field-for-field the block in
workload Flow C already solves and runs on this board.

qrb5165_flowc.description: QRB5165 v66 through Flow C: HTA (CPU_P) + Hexagon v66 DSP (CPU_E) + Kryo 585 CPU (CPU_X), one lane each. Profiles are the tile-level results.csv files flowc/artifacts.py writes from measurements/qrb5165_v66.json.
